title: Kabocha crowdloan campaign strategy discussion
body:
## **Kabocha crowdloan campaign strategy - discussion**

This post relates to Kabocha and our strategy for securing a slot on Kusama by acquiring enough KSM to win an auction.

The key question this post addresses is a simple one...

_**In order to acquire the KSM required, should we encourage our community of EDG holders to also contribute KSM to the crowdloan in return for receiving their KAB?**_

## **UPDATE: Monday 13th December - Poll live. **

If the answer is **NO**, then we will continue as before. 

If the answer is **YES**, then the follow on question is: 

_**How do we do this in the simplest, fairest and most community oriented led approach possible?**_

We want KAB to happen, so we need your input / ideas and feedback and we'll update this post as we go.

If you haven;'t already please read the following so you have context. 

[Kabocha (KAB): A Kusama Parachain Project by Edgeware ](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/2363-kabocha-kab-a-kusama-parachain-project-by-edgeware)

From the above project outline: 

> _We will be delivering the Edgeware community into the Kusama ecosystem through an 100% undiluted distribution for Edgeware token holders. _
> _We’re doing it in Edgeware style, staying true to a fully community backed approach, while capturing the spirit of Kusama. _

## **The challenge**

- Currently the intended 'snapshot' offers a path for EDG holders to receive KAB if we win an auction, however it does not present a solution to how we acquire the required KSM to make that a reality in the first place. 
- We could rely on newcomers to Edgeware/Kabocha locking KSM, but this doesn't make the most of our own community, who remain passive and should be at the heart of this crowdloan campaign and key to securing the KSM we require. 
- We want to steer clear of early bird and referral bonuses and rely on our community.
